name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
locator: Printed p. 17 (PDF p. 10), Table 1, 1895 row. The official 1912 report, printed pp. iv–v, identifies the 1895 enumeration date and coverage by local presence.
definition: Bosnia and Herzegovina as one territory under Austro-Hungarian administration. Excludes the territories of the Austrian and Hungarian halves and the Ottoman-administered Sanjak of Novi-Pazar. The two CShapes areas are a joint approximate map association; the observations provide no population split between them. Locally present civilians of both sexes. The active military is excluded. Civilian persons present from outside the territory are in scope, with no addition for persons absent from the territory.

locator: Bosanska vila, no. 13, printed p. 214; civilian subtotal derived by subtracting active military and confirmed in Demography 2024, printed p. 17.
